ta_read.text: SPY's daily swings show lower highs and lower lows; the last structure break was down on Nov 17, when it closed below $732.71. On weekly bars it is in a downtrend (below its 10- and 40-week averages), and the weekly swings show mixed swings (a range).

Over the last 25 sessions there were 9 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 2 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (-3.6%) came on heavy volume.
RSI is 25 (oversold); MACD is below its signal line since Oct 15.
A daily close above $698.74 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $681.89 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.

In my opinion the lean is down, though an RSI of 25 (oversold) allows a bounce. A close above $698.74 would ease the concern, and a close below $681.89 would confirm weakness.
